# THE HARBOUR: a working port at golden hour. The frigate (below, unchanged) lies alongside a stone quay on the sim ocean she floats on; behind the quay a cobbled plaza, a waterfront town
# of gabled houses with lit windows, a customs house, a harbour crane, lamps, cargo and bollards; to seaward a stone mole with a lighthouse, a wooden jetty with moored fishing boats, and gulls
# turning overhead; behind the town the land rises into wooded hills. Everything is generated by our own language; every repeated thing (windows, bollards, lamps, crates, rocks, trees, gulls) is a
# shared instance set, stored once. Metres, +y up. The frigate's world is kept as it was: she faces +z, midships at the origin, mean sea level y = 2; the quay face is the plane x = -9.
# (the frigate's own header follows)
# FRIGATE, after USS CONSTITUTION (1797). BRIEF: a three-masted 44-gun frigate: 62 m on deck, 53.3 m at the waterline, beam 13.26 m, draft 6.4 m forward and 7.0 m aft,
# spar deck 4.9 m above the water, 15 long guns a side on the gun deck, masts 60 / 67 / 52.6 m, bowsprit to spanker boom 93 m, copper-sheathed below the waterline.
# Sources: Wikipedia and the US Navy fact file (sizes); the sources disagree on what height the masts are measured from, so heights here are above the waterline, scaled from
# the 198 / 220 / 172.5 ft figures and anchored to 172 ft from the spar deck to the main truck (= 57.3 m above the water). Yard lengths and mast positions are ESTIMATED from model plans.
# Built like the car: every dimension is a named value; the hull is a LOFT of cross-sections along its length (the naval architect's body plan: half-beam, keel line and sheer
# are tables), subdivided; the deck, bulwarks and gun ports are cut out of it and each opening is filled with its own material. engine/tools/audit-ship.ts measures the
# evaluated mesh against the real dimensions and says which value to change.
# Metres, +y up, the ship faces +z (bow), waterline at y = 0, midships near z = 0.
# kind: world
# late afternoon: the sun over the open sea on the +x side (the sun's light travels toward -x, onto the quay-facing facades), warm, long shadows, a little haze for distance
sky = scene.sky@1(sun_elevation=42, sun_azimuth=-65, sun_intensity=3.4, turbidity=2.2, ground_color=[0.25, 0.3, 0.34], clouds=true, cloud_cover=0.35, seed=11, haze=0.01, haze_color=[0.78, 0.85, 0.95])
env = scene.environment@1(sky_color=[0.62, 0.74, 0.92], ground_color=[0.32, 0.36, 0.38], intensity=1.05, reflection=0.5, bounce=0.4)
output sky = sky
output env = env

# ---------------- PARAMETER TABLE ----------------
let beam = "13.26"
let draft_aft = "7.0"
let draft_fwd = "6.4"
let freeboard = "4.9"
# ports: the gun deck's 15 ports a side, their centre height and spacing
let port_y = "2.9"
let port_gap = "2.2"
# --------------------------------------------------

# shared by the hull, deck and ports: piecewise-linear lookup of the body plan, and the half-width of the hull at a height
let jsh = "const pl = (k, z) => { if (z <= k[0][0]) return k[0][1]; for (let i = 1; i < k.length; i++) { if (z <= k[i][0]) { const t = (z - k[i - 1][0]) / (k[i][0] - k[i - 1][0]); return k[i - 1][1] + (k[i][1] - k[i - 1][1]) * t; } } return k[k.length - 1][1]; }; const BEAM = ${beam}, DA = ${draft_aft}, DF = ${draft_fwd}, FB = ${freeboard}; const bK = [[-29, 3.9], [-27, 4.7], [-24, 5.7], [-16, 6.45], [-8, 6.63], [0, 6.63], [8, 6.5], [16, 5.9], [22, 4.6], [26, 2.4], [28, 1.3], [30, 0.7], [33, 0.2]]; const yK = [[-29, 3.0], [-26.5, 0], [-24, -DA * 0.57], [-20, -DA * 0.99], [-10, -DA], [19, -DF], [23, -DF * 0.7], [26.8, 0], [29, 2.5], [31, 4.5], [33, 6.5]]; const dK = [[-29, FB + 1.4], [-9.2, FB + 1.4], [-8, FB], [21, FB], [22.2, FB + 1.4], [33, FB + 1.4]]; const half = (z) => pl(bK, z) * BEAM / 13.26; const railY = (z) => pl(dK, z) + 1.15; const fS = [[0, 1.0], [0.22, 1.012], [0.45, 1.0], [0.70, 0.965], [1, 0.935]]; const y0Of = (z) => Math.min(Math.max(0, pl(yK, z) + (pl(yK, z) > 0 ? 1.0 : 0)), railY(z) - 0.3); const sideX = (z, y) => { const y0 = y0Of(z), r = railY(z); return half(z) * pl(fS, Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (y - y0) / (r - y0)))); }; const ring = (rh) => { const r = rh.slice(); for (let i = rh.length - 2; i >= 1; i--) r.push([-rh[i][0], rh[i][1]]); return r; };"
# the hull rings: the keel line up to the waterline in eight points (U-shaped section), then tumblehome up to the rail, then across the top
let hull_code = "${jsh} const m = new Mesh(); const S = [0, 0.22, 0.45, 0.66, 0.82, 0.93, 0.985, 1.0], Hh = [0, 0.035, 0.10, 0.22, 0.42, 0.65, 0.87, 1.0], U = [0.22, 0.45, 0.70, 1.0]; const fn = (z) => { const b = half(z), yk = pl(yK, z), r = railY(z), y0 = y0Of(z); const out = []; for (let i = 0; i < S.length; i++) out.push([b * S[i], yk + (y0 - yk) * Hh[i]]); for (let i = 0; i < U.length; i++) out.push([b * pl(fS, U[i]), y0 + (r - y0) * U[i]]); const e = b * 0.935, d = Math.min(0.2, e * 0.4); out.push([e - d, r]); out.push([e * 0.5, r]); out.push([0, r]); return out; }; const zs = []; const N = 64; for (let i = 0; i <= N; i++) zs.push(-29 + 62 * i / N); const rows = zs.map((z) => ring(fn(z)).map((q) => m.vertex(q[0], q[1], z))); const n = rows[0].length; for (let k = 0; k < rows.length - 1; k++) for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) { const j2 = (j + 1) % n; m.face(rows[k][j], rows[k][j2], rows[k + 1][j2], rows[k + 1][j]); } const cf = m.vertex(0, (pl(yK, 33) + railY(33)) / 2, 33), cb = m.vertex(0, (pl(yK, -29) + railY(-29)) / 2, -29); for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) { const j2 = (j + 1) % n; m.face(cf, rows[rows.length - 1][j], rows[rows.length - 1][j2]); m.face(cb, rows[0][j2], rows[0][j]); } m"
# the open deck: a loft inset by the bulwark thickness (0.3 m), from 0.08 m below the deck up past the rail (cut), and the same 0.08 m plate (the deck planking); steps follow the deck table
let deck_body = "${jsh} const m = new Mesh(); const zs = []; const N = 90; for (let i = 0; i <= N; i++) zs.push(-28.7 + 60.1 * i / N); for (const e of [-9.2, -8.6, -8, 21, 21.6, 22.2]) zs.push(e); zs.sort((a, b) => a - b); for (let i = zs.length - 1; i > 0; i--) if (zs[i] - zs[i - 1] < 0.08) zs.splice(i, 1); const fn = (z) => { const bi = Math.max(half(z) * 0.935 - 0.3, 0.05), dy = pl(dK, z); return [[0, dy - 0.08], [bi * 0.5, dy - 0.08], [bi, dy - 0.08], [bi, TOP(z, dy)], [bi * 0.5, TOP(z, dy)], [0, TOP(z, dy)]]; }; const rows = zs.map((z) => ring(fn(z)).map((q) => m.vertex(q[0], q[1], z))); const n = rows[0].length; for (let k = 0; k < rows.length - 1; k++) for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) { const j2 = (j + 1) % n; m.face(rows[k][j], rows[k][j2], rows[k + 1][j2], rows[k + 1][j]); } const cf = m.vertex(0, (fn(zs[zs.length - 1])[0][1] + fn(zs[zs.length - 1])[3][1]) / 2, zs[zs.length - 1]), cb = m.vertex(0, (fn(zs[0])[0][1] + fn(zs[0])[3][1]) / 2, zs[0]); for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) { const j2 = (j + 1) % n; m.face(cf, rows[rows.length - 1][j], rows[rows.length - 1][j2]); m.face(cb, rows[0][j2], rows[0][j]); } m"
# gun ports: a closed box for every port, both sides, positioned from the hull's own width at the port height; `deep` is how far in it reaches, `out` how far past the surface
let ports_body = "${jsh} const m = new Mesh(); const box = (x0, x1, y0, y1, z0, z1) => { const v = [[x0, y0, z0], [x1, y0, z0], [x1, y1, z0], [x0, y1, z0], [x0, y0, z1], [x1, y0, z1], [x1, y1, z1], [x0, y1, z1]].map((p) => m.vertex(p[0], p[1], p[2])); m.face(v[0], v[3], v[2], v[1]); m.face(v[4], v[5], v[6], v[7]); m.face(v[0], v[1], v[5], v[4]); m.face(v[3], v[7], v[6], v[2]); m.face(v[0], v[4], v[7], v[3]); m.face(v[1], v[2], v[6], v[5]); }; for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) { const z = -15.4 + ${port_gap} * i, py = ${port_y}, sx = sideX(z, py); for (const s of [1, -1]) { const a = s * (sx - DEEP), b = s * (sx + OUT); box(Math.min(a, b), Math.max(a, b), py - 0.38, py + 0.38, z - 0.42, z + 0.42); } } m"
# the guns: a ten-sided barrel through each port, muzzle out past the hull
let guns_body = "${jsh} const m = new Mesh(); const barrel = (x0, x1, y, z, r) => { const a = [], b = []; for (let k = 0; k < 10; k++) { const t = 2 * Math.PI * k / 10; a.push(m.vertex(x0, y + r * Math.cos(t), z + r * Math.sin(t))); b.push(m.vertex(x1, y + r * Math.cos(t), z + r * Math.sin(t))); } for (let k = 0; k < 10; k++) { const k2 = (k + 1) % 10; m.face(a[k], a[k2], b[k2], b[k]); } m.face(...a.slice().reverse()); m.face(...b); }; for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) { const z = -15.4 + ${port_gap} * i, py = ${port_y}, sx = sideX(z, py); barrel(sx - 0.5, sx + 0.55, py, z, 0.17); barrel(-sx - 0.55, -sx + 0.5, py, z, 0.17); } m"

hull_s = poly.script@1(code="${hull_code}", budget=8000)
hull_sub = poly.subdivide@1(hull_s, levels=2)
hull_solid = poly.to_solid@1(hull_sub)
cut_s = poly.script@1(code="const TOP = (z, dy) => railY(z) + 0.6; ${deck_body}", budget=6000)
cut_sub = poly.subdivide@1(cut_s, levels=1)
cut_solid = poly.to_solid@1(cut_sub)
plate_s = poly.script@1(code="const TOP = (z, dy) => dy; ${deck_body}", budget=6000)
plate_sub = poly.subdivide@1(plate_s, levels=1)
plate_solid = poly.to_solid@1(plate_sub)
ports_cut_s = poly.script@1(code="const DEEP = 0.55, OUT = 0.25; ${ports_body}", budget=4000)
ports_cut = poly.to_solid@1(ports_cut_s)
ports_fill_s = poly.script@1(code="const DEEP = 0.55, OUT = -0.1; ${ports_body}", budget=4000)
ports_fill = poly.to_solid@1(ports_fill_s)
guns_s = poly.script@1(code="${guns_body}", budget=4000)
guns_solid = poly.to_solid@1(guns_s)

# ---- stern windows: five panes in the transom, a cutter and its fill ----
win_b = solid.box@1(size=[0.9, 1.1, 0.5])
win_1 = xform.move@1(win_b, by=[-3.2, 6.0, -28.9])
win_2 = xform.move@1(win_b, by=[-1.6, 6.0, -28.9])
win_3 = xform.move@1(win_b, by=[0, 6.0, -28.9])
win_4 = xform.move@1(win_b, by=[1.6, 6.0, -28.9])
win_5 = xform.move@1(win_b, by=[3.2, 6.0, -28.9])
win_u = solid.union@1(win_1, win_2, win_3, win_4, win_5)

# ---- the hull: the deck cut away, ports cut away; then split into colour bands with the same planes the car's inlays used ----
hull_open = solid.difference@1(hull_solid, cut_solid)
hull_paint = solid.difference@1(hull_open, ports_cut, win_u)
band_copper_b = solid.box@1(size=[30, 12.3, 100])
band_copper = xform.move@1(band_copper_b, by=[0, -5.85, 2])
band_low_b = solid.box@1(size=[30, 1.85, 100])
band_low = xform.move@1(band_low_b, by=[0, 1.225, 2])
band_ochre_b = solid.box@1(size=[30, 1.5, 100])
band_ochre = xform.move@1(band_ochre_b, by=[0, 2.9, 2])
band_high_b = solid.box@1(size=[30, 8, 100])
band_high = xform.move@1(band_high_b, by=[0, 7.65, 2])
hull_copper = solid.intersect@1(hull_paint, band_copper)
copper_m = solid.material@1(hull_copper, color=[0.5, 0.3, 0.2], metallic=0.8, roughness=0.42)
copper_h = anim.parent@1(copper_m, parent="hull")
output hull_copper = copper_h
hull_low = solid.intersect@1(hull_paint, band_low)
low_m = solid.material@1(hull_low, color=[0.025, 0.025, 0.03], roughness=0.55)
low_h = anim.parent@1(low_m, parent="hull")
output hull_black_low = low_h
hull_ochre_s = solid.intersect@1(hull_paint, band_ochre)
ochre_m = solid.material@1(hull_ochre_s, color=[0.72, 0.55, 0.14], roughness=0.6)
ochre_h = anim.parent@1(ochre_m, parent="hull")
output hull_ochre = ochre_h
hull_high = solid.intersect@1(hull_paint, band_high)
high_m = solid.material@1(hull_high, color=[0.025, 0.025, 0.03], roughness=0.55)
high_h = anim.parent@1(high_m, parent="hull")
output hull_black_high = high_h
ports_dark_s = solid.intersect@1(hull_open, ports_fill)
ports_dark_m = solid.material@1(ports_dark_s, color=[0.01, 0.01, 0.012], roughness=0.9)
ports_dark_h = anim.parent@1(ports_dark_m, parent="hull")
output gun_ports = ports_dark_h
win_dark_s = solid.intersect@1(hull_open, win_u)
win_dark_m = solid.material@1(win_dark_s, color=[0.04, 0.06, 0.09], metallic=0.3, roughness=0.1)
win_dark_h = anim.parent@1(win_dark_m, parent="hull")
output stern_windows = win_dark_h
plate_m = solid.material@1(plate_solid, color=[0.55, 0.42, 0.25], roughness=0.85, recipe="planks")
plate_h = anim.parent@1(plate_m, parent="hull")
output deck = plate_h
guns_m = solid.material@1(guns_solid, color=[0.05, 0.05, 0.055], metallic=0.7, roughness=0.5)
guns_h = anim.parent@1(guns_m, parent="hull")
output guns = guns_h
# the rudder hangs behind the stern post
rud_b = solid.box@1(size=[0.35, 7.0, 0.9])
rud_at = xform.move@1(rud_b, by=[0, -2.3, -27.9])
rud_m = solid.material@1(rud_at, color=[0.14, 0.09, 0.05], roughness=0.8)
rud_h = anim.parent@1(rud_m, parent="hull")
output rudder = rud_h

# ================= THE RIG =================
# mast heights above the waterline: main 57.3 m (172 ft deck to truck + 4.9 m freeboard); fore and mizzen scaled by 198/220 and 172.5/220 (Navy fact file); rake aft in degrees
let main_h = "57.3"
let fore_h = "51.6"
let mizzen_h = "44.9"
let rake_deg = "2"
# mast positions along the ship (z): estimated from model plans
let fore_z = "17.0"
let main_z = "-2.0"
let mizzen_z = "-19.0"

# the mast leans aft, so every spar and sail is placed at the mast's z for ITS height
let jsr = "const RK = ${rake_deg} * Math.PI / 180; const zAt = (mz, y) => mz - Math.sin(RK) * y;"
# a rope or spar: an n-sided prism between two points (n = 4 for a rope, 10 for a spar), closed and outward-facing
let jsrope = "const rope = (m, a, b, r, n) => { const d = [b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1], b[2] - a[2]]; const L = Math.hypot(d[0], d[1], d[2]); const t = [d[0] / L, d[1] / L, d[2] / L]; const up = Math.abs(t[1]) > 0.9 ? [1, 0, 0] : [0, 1, 0]; let n1 = [t[1] * up[2] - t[2] * up[1], t[2] * up[0] - t[0] * up[2], t[0] * up[1] - t[1] * up[0]]; const l1 = Math.hypot(n1[0], n1[1], n1[2]); n1 = n1.map((v) => v / l1); const n2 = [t[1] * n1[2] - t[2] * n1[1], t[2] * n1[0] - t[0] * n1[2], t[0] * n1[1] - t[1] * n1[0]]; const A = [], B = []; for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) { const th = 2 * Math.PI * k / n, c = Math.cos(th), s = Math.sin(th); const o = [r * (c * n1[0] + s * n2[0]), r * (c * n1[1] + s * n2[1]), r * (c * n1[2] + s * n2[2])]; A.push(m.vertex(a[0] + o[0], a[1] + o[1], a[2] + o[2])); B.push(m.vertex(b[0] + o[0], b[1] + o[1], b[2] + o[2])); } for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) { const k2 = (k + 1) % n; m.face(A[k], A[k2], B[k2]); m.face(A[k], B[k2], B[k]); } m.face(...A.slice().reverse()); m.face(...B); };"

# a mast: four tapered segments (lower, top, topgallant, royal pole) revolved, a top platform, raked aft; r0 is the radius at the deck
def mast(tag, mz, mh, r0, rake)
  mp{tag}_a = profile.polygon@1(points=[[0, 4.0], [{r0}, 4.0], [{r0 * 0.72}, {mh * 0.5}], [0, {mh * 0.5}]])
  mp{tag}_b = profile.polygon@1(points=[[0, {mh * 0.42}], [{r0 * 0.58}, {mh * 0.42}], [{r0 * 0.42}, {mh * 0.78}], [0, {mh * 0.78}]])
  mp{tag}_c = profile.polygon@1(points=[[0, {mh * 0.72}], [{r0 * 0.33}, {mh * 0.72}], [{r0 * 0.23}, {mh * 0.93}], [0, {mh * 0.93}]])
  mp{tag}_d = profile.polygon@1(points=[[0, {mh * 0.89}], [{r0 * 0.19}, {mh * 0.89}], [{r0 * 0.09}, {mh}], [0, {mh}]])
  mr{tag}_a = solid.revolve@1(mp{tag}_a, angle=360deg, segments=16)
  mr{tag}_b = solid.revolve@1(mp{tag}_b, angle=360deg, segments=14)
  mr{tag}_c = solid.revolve@1(mp{tag}_c, angle=360deg, segments=12)
  mr{tag}_d = solid.revolve@1(mp{tag}_d, angle=360deg, segments=10)
  mt{tag}_p = solid.box@1(size=[{mh * 0.062}, 0.2, {mh * 0.05}])
  mt{tag}_q = xform.move@1(mt{tag}_p, by=[0, {mh * 0.5}, 0.2])
  mu{tag} = solid.union@1(mr{tag}_a, mr{tag}_b, mr{tag}_c, mr{tag}_d, mt{tag}_q)
  mk{tag} = xform.rotate@1(mu{tag}, angles=[{0 - rake}, 0, 0])
  mm{tag} = xform.move@1(mk{tag}, by=[0, 0, {mz}])
  mc{tag} = solid.material@1(mm{tag}, color=[0.5, 0.36, 0.2], roughness=0.8)
  mq{tag} = anim.parent@1(mc{tag}, parent="hull")
  output mast_{tag} = mq{tag}
end
mast("fore", 17.0, 51.6, 0.4, 2)
mast("main", -2.0, 57.3, 0.45, 2)
mast("mizzen", -19.0, 44.9, 0.35, 2)

# bowsprit: 15 degrees above horizontal, 34.2 m long, from inside the forecastle to a tip at z = 61
bs_p = profile.polygon@1(points=[[0, 0], [0.42, 0], [0.12, 34.2], [0, 34.2]])
bs_r = solid.revolve@1(bs_p, angle=360deg, segments=14)
bs_t = xform.rotate@1(bs_r, angles=[75, 0, 0])
bs_a = xform.move@1(bs_t, by=[0, 6.8, 28.0])
bs_m = solid.material@1(bs_a, color=[0.5, 0.36, 0.2], roughness=0.8)
bs_h = anim.parent@1(bs_m, parent="hull")
output bowsprit = bs_h

# yards: [mast z, height, length, radius]; course, topsail, topgallant, royal on the fore and main, crossjack and three above it on the mizzen (lengths estimated)
let yards_code = "${jsr} ${jsrope} const m = new Mesh(); const Y = [[17.0, 10.4, 24, 0.3], [17.0, 23.5, 19.5, 0.24], [17.0, 35, 13.5, 0.17], [17.0, 43, 9, 0.12], [-2.0, 11.5, 27, 0.33], [-2.0, 25.5, 22, 0.27], [-2.0, 38, 15, 0.19], [-2.0, 47, 10, 0.13], [-19.0, 10.0, 19, 0.26], [-19.0, 21, 15.5, 0.2], [-19.0, 31, 10.5, 0.15], [-19.0, 38.5, 7, 0.1]]; for (const q of Y) rope(m, [-q[2] / 2, q[1], zAt(q[0], q[1]) + 0.55], [q[2] / 2, q[1], zAt(q[0], q[1]) + 0.55], q[3], 10); m"
yards_s = poly.script@1(code="${yards_code}", budget=4000)
yards_m = solid.material@1(yards_s, color=[0.5, 0.36, 0.2], roughness=0.8)
yards_h = anim.parent@1(yards_m, parent="hull")
output yards = yards_h
# the spanker's boom (to z = -31.9, past the taffrail) and gaff
let spars_code = "${jsrope} const m = new Mesh(); rope(m, [0, 9, -19.9], [0, 9, -31.9], 0.17, 10); rope(m, [0, 23.5, -19.9], [0, 28.5, -30.4], 0.13, 10); m"
spars_s = poly.script@1(code="${spars_code}", budget=2000)
spars_m = solid.material@1(spars_s, color=[0.5, 0.36, 0.2], roughness=0.8)
spars_h = anim.parent@1(spars_m, parent="hull")
output spanker_boom = spars_h

# standing rigging, ONE script: five shrouds a side on each mast, thirteen rungs of ratlines between every pair, backstays, and the stays between the masts and out to the bowsprit
let rig_code = "${jsh} ${jsr} ${jsrope} const m = new Mesh(); const masts = [[${fore_z}, ${fore_h}], [${main_z}, ${main_h}], [${mizzen_z}, ${mizzen_h}]]; for (const M of masts) { const ty = M[1] * 0.5; for (const s of [1, -1]) { const top = [], low = []; for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) { const zl = M[0] + (i - 2) * 0.95; top.push([s * 1.3, ty, zAt(M[0], ty) + (i - 2) * 0.3]); low.push([s * (sideX(zl, 5.3) + 0.28), 5.3, zl]); rope(m, low[i], top[i], 0.045, 4); } for (let k = 1; k <= 13; k++) { const t = 0.1 + k * 0.05; const p = (q) => [low[q][0] + (top[q][0] - low[q][0]) * t, low[q][1] + (top[q][1] - low[q][1]) * t, low[q][2] + (top[q][2] - low[q][2]) * t]; for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) rope(m, p(i), p(i + 1), 0.018, 4); } const th = M[1] * 0.78; for (const dz of [-1.2, -2.6]) { const zl = M[0] + dz * 2.2 - 1.0; rope(m, [s * 0.7, th, zAt(M[0], th) - 0.3], [s * (sideX(zl, 5.3) + 0.28), 5.3, zl], 0.035, 4); } } } rope(m, [0, ${fore_h} * 0.78, zAt(${fore_z}, ${fore_h} * 0.78)], [0, 13.5, 52], 0.05, 4); rope(m, [0, ${main_h} * 0.78, zAt(${main_z}, ${main_h} * 0.78)], [0, 11, ${fore_z} + 0.4], 0.05, 4); rope(m, [0, ${mizzen_h} * 0.78, zAt(${mizzen_z}, ${mizzen_h} * 0.78)], [0, 11, ${main_z} - 0.4], 0.05, 4); rope(m, [0, ${fore_h} * 0.93, zAt(${fore_z}, ${fore_h} * 0.93)], [0, 12, 58], 0.04, 4); m"
rig_s = poly.script@1(code="${rig_code}", budget=12000)
rig_m = solid.material@1(rig_s, color=[0.12, 0.09, 0.06], roughness=0.9)
rig_h = anim.parent@1(rig_m, parent="hull")
output rigging = rig_h

# sails: a grid of vertices per sail, billowed forward (the wind is from astern), double-sided canvas; one mesh per mast. [top y, foot y, head width, foot width, billow]
let sail_fn = "const NU = 12, NV = 8; const sail = (m, mz, yt, yb, wt, wb, bel) => { const g = []; for (let iv = 0; iv <= NV; iv++) { const v = iv / NV, y = yt + (yb - yt) * v, w = wt + (wb - wt) * v, row = []; for (let iu = 0; iu <= NU; iu++) { const u = iu / NU; row.push(m.vertex((u - 0.5) * w, y, zAt(mz, y) + 0.62 + bel * Math.sin(Math.PI * u) * Math.sin(Math.PI * (0.08 + 0.84 * v)))); } g.push(row); } for (let iv = 0; iv < NV; iv++) for (let iu = 0; iu < NU; iu++) { m.face(g[iv][iu], g[iv][iu + 1], g[iv + 1][iu + 1], g[iv + 1][iu]); } };"
let sails_main = "${jsr} ${sail_fn} const m = new Mesh(); sail(m, -2.0, 11.3, 5.9, 26.5, 28, 1.5); sail(m, -2.0, 25.3, 12.9, 21.5, 25, 1.7); sail(m, -2.0, 37.8, 26.2, 14.8, 20, 1.3); sail(m, -2.0, 46.8, 39.0, 9.8, 13, 0.8); m"
let sails_fore = "${jsr} ${sail_fn} const m = new Mesh(); sail(m, 17.0, 10.2, 5.6, 23.6, 25, 1.4); sail(m, 17.0, 23.3, 12.0, 19, 22.5, 1.5); sail(m, 17.0, 34.8, 24.0, 13.3, 17.5, 1.2); sail(m, 17.0, 42.8, 35.8, 8.8, 11.5, 0.7); m"
let sails_mizzen = "${jsr} ${sail_fn} const m = new Mesh(); sail(m, -19.0, 20.8, 11.0, 15.3, 19, 1.2); sail(m, -19.0, 30.8, 22.5, 10.3, 14, 0.9); sail(m, -19.0, 38.3, 32.3, 6.8, 9, 0.6); m"
# CLOTH: every sail is its own mesh run by a position-based cloth program (SimL, as in the armada). Its pinned vertices ride the hull body; the rest are blown by a gusty wind from astern
# (+z), pulled down by gravity, and held by their rest edge lengths. Square sails are pinned along the yard (top row) and at the two foot corners (the sheets); jibs along the luff;
# the spanker along the mast, the boom and the gaff. Each source differs only in its pin test.
let square_src = "sim sail\nparam wind = vec3(1.4, 0.0, 6.0)\nparam gust = 0.6\nparam damping = 0.98\nparam top = 0.0\nparam bot = 0.0\nparam hw = 1.0\ninput mesh sail\ninput bone hull\nstate pos: vec3[sail]\nstate prev: vec3[sail]\nkernel init each i in pos {\n  let w = bone_point(hull, rest(sail, i))\n  pos[i] = w\n  prev[i] = w\n}\nkernel predict each i in pos {\n  let r = rest(sail, i)\n  let pin = r.y > top - 0.05 || (r.y < bot + 0.05 && abs(r.x) > hw - 0.5)\n  let w = bone_point(hull, r)\n  if pin || distance(pos[i], w) > 8.0 {\n    pos[i] = w\n    prev[i] = w\n  } else {\n    let v = (pos[i] - prev[i]) * damping\n    v = v * min(1.0, 0.12 / max(length(v), 0.0001))\n    prev[i] = pos[i]\n    let puff = wind * (1.0 + gust * sin(t * 1.7 + r.y * 0.6 + r.x * 0.5))\n    pos[i] += v + (vec3(0.0, -9.8, 0.0) + puff * 2.4) * dt * dt\n  }\n}\nkernel solve each i in pos {\n  let r = rest(sail, i)\n  let pin = r.y > top - 0.05 || (r.y < bot + 0.05 && abs(r.x) > hw - 0.5)\n  let p = pos[i]\n  if !pin {\n    let corr = vec3(0.0)\n    let count = 0.0\n    for j, len in adjacent(sail, i) {\n      let rj = rest(sail, j)\n      let pj = rj.y > top - 0.05 || (rj.y < bot + 0.05 && abs(rj.x) > hw - 0.5)\n      corr += pull(p, pos[j], len) * select(pj, 1.0, 0.5)\n      count += 1.0\n    }\n    if count > 0.0 {\n      p += corr * (1.3 / count)\n    }\n  }\n  pos[i] = p\n}\nschedule predict; repeat 6 { solve }\noutput mesh pos\n"
let jib_src = "sim jib\nparam wind = vec3(1.4, 0.0, 6.0)\nparam gust = 0.6\nparam damping = 0.98\nparam pa = 0.0\nparam pb = 0.0\nparam pc = 0.0\ninput mesh sail\ninput bone hull\nstate pos: vec3[sail]\nstate prev: vec3[sail]\nkernel init each i in pos {\n  let w = bone_point(hull, rest(sail, i))\n  pos[i] = w\n  prev[i] = w\n}\nkernel predict each i in pos {\n  let r = rest(sail, i)\n  let pin = pa * r.y + pb * r.z > pc\n  let w = bone_point(hull, r)\n  if pin || distance(pos[i], w) > 8.0 {\n    pos[i] = w\n    prev[i] = w\n  } else {\n    let v = (pos[i] - prev[i]) * damping\n    v = v * min(1.0, 0.12 / max(length(v), 0.0001))\n    prev[i] = pos[i]\n    let puff = wind * (1.0 + gust * sin(t * 1.9 + r.y * 0.5 + r.z * 0.4))\n    pos[i] += v + (vec3(0.0, -9.8, 0.0) + puff * 2.4) * dt * dt\n  }\n}\nkernel solve each i in pos {\n  let r = rest(sail, i)\n  let pin = pa * r.y + pb * r.z > pc\n  let p = pos[i]\n  if !pin {\n    let corr = vec3(0.0)\n    let count = 0.0\n    for j, len in adjacent(sail, i) {\n      let rj = rest(sail, j)\n      let pj = pa * rj.y + pb * rj.z > pc\n      corr += pull(p, pos[j], len) * select(pj, 1.0, 0.5)\n      count += 1.0\n    }\n    if count > 0.0 {\n      p += corr * (1.3 / count)\n    }\n  }\n  pos[i] = p\n}\nschedule predict; repeat 6 { solve }\noutput mesh pos\n"
let span_src = "sim spanker\nparam wind = vec3(1.4, 0.0, 6.0)\nparam gust = 0.6\nparam damping = 0.98\ninput mesh sail\ninput bone hull\nstate pos: vec3[sail]\nstate prev: vec3[sail]\nkernel init each i in pos {\n  let w = bone_point(hull, rest(sail, i))\n  pos[i] = w\n  prev[i] = w\n}\nkernel predict each i in pos {\n  let r = rest(sail, i)\n  let pin = r.z > -20.3 || r.y < 9.05 || 9.9 * r.y + 5.0 * r.z > 132.05\n  let w = bone_point(hull, r)\n  if pin || distance(pos[i], w) > 8.0 {\n    pos[i] = w\n    prev[i] = w\n  } else {\n    let v = (pos[i] - prev[i]) * damping\n    v = v * min(1.0, 0.12 / max(length(v), 0.0001))\n    prev[i] = pos[i]\n    let puff = wind * (1.0 + gust * sin(t * 1.6 + r.y * 0.5 + r.z * 0.4))\n    pos[i] += v + (vec3(0.0, -9.8, 0.0) + puff * 2.4) * dt * dt\n  }\n}\nkernel solve each i in pos {\n  let r = rest(sail, i)\n  let pin = r.z > -20.3 || r.y < 9.05 || 9.9 * r.y + 5.0 * r.z > 132.05\n  let p = pos[i]\n  if !pin {\n    let corr = vec3(0.0)\n    let count = 0.0\n    for j, len in adjacent(sail, i) {\n      let rj = rest(sail, j)\n      let pj = rj.z > -20.3 || rj.y < 9.05 || 9.9 * rj.y + 5.0 * rj.z > 132.05\n      corr += pull(p, pos[j], len) * select(pj, 1.0, 0.5)\n      count += 1.0\n    }\n    if count > 0.0 {\n      p += corr * (1.3 / count)\n    }\n  }\n  pos[i] = p\n}\nschedule predict; repeat 6 { solve }\noutput mesh pos\n"
def sq(tag, mz, yt, yb, wt, wb, bel, hw)
  sq{tag}_s = poly.script@1(code="${jsr} ${sail_fn} const m = new Mesh(); sail(m, ${mz}, ${yt}, ${yb}, ${wt}, ${wb}, ${bel}); m", budget=2000)
  sq{tag}_p = sim.program@1(sq{tag}_s, rate=30, values="top=${yt}; bot=${yb}; hw=${hw}", source="${square_src}")
  sq{tag}_m = solid.material@1(sq{tag}_p, color=[0.9, 0.86, 0.74], metallic=0.0, roughness=1.0)
  sq{tag}_f = solid.finish@1(sq{tag}_m, sheen=0.35, translucency=0.3)
  output sail_{tag} = sq{tag}_f
end
sq("m1", -2.0, 11.3, 5.9, 26.5, 28, 1.5, 14)
sq("m2", -2.0, 25.3, 12.9, 21.5, 25, 1.7, 12.5)
sq("m3", -2.0, 37.8, 26.2, 14.8, 20, 1.3, 10)
# the renderer runs at most 16 sim programs at once (12 sails + 3 jibs-and-spanker + sea + buoyancy would be 17), so the three small royals are shaped sails that ride the hull
def sr(tag, mz, yt, yb, wt, wb, bel)
  sr{tag}_s = poly.script@1(code="${jsr} ${sail_fn} const m = new Mesh(); sail(m, ${mz}, ${yt}, ${yb}, ${wt}, ${wb}, ${bel}); m", budget=2000)
  sr{tag}_m = solid.material@1(sr{tag}_s, color=[0.9, 0.86, 0.74], metallic=0.0, roughness=1.0)
  sr{tag}_f = solid.finish@1(sr{tag}_m, sheen=0.35, translucency=0.3)
  sr{tag}_h = anim.parent@1(sr{tag}_f, parent="hull")
  output sail_{tag} = sr{tag}_h
end
sr("m4", -2.0, 46.8, 39.0, 9.8, 13, 0.8)
sq("f1", 17.0, 10.2, 5.6, 23.6, 25, 1.4, 12.5)
sq("f2", 17.0, 23.3, 12.0, 19, 22.5, 1.5, 11.25)
sq("f3", 17.0, 34.8, 24.0, 13.3, 17.5, 1.2, 8.75)
sr("f4", 17.0, 42.8, 35.8, 8.8, 11.5, 0.7)
sq("z1", -19.0, 20.8, 11.0, 15.3, 19, 1.2, 9.5)
sq("z2", -19.0, 30.8, 22.5, 10.3, 14, 0.9, 7)
sr("z3", -19.0, 38.3, 32.3, 6.8, 9, 0.6)
# jibs (triangles between the foremast and the bowsprit, billowed to starboard) and the spanker (between boom and gaff)
let jibs_code = "const m = new Mesh(); const N = 12; const jib = (hy, hz, ty, tz, cy, cz, bel) => { const A = [hy, hz], B = [ty, tz], C = [cy, cz]; const V = []; for (let i = 0; i <= N; i++) { const row = []; for (let j = 0; j <= N - i; j++) { const u = i / N, v = j / N, w = 1 - u - v; row.push(m.vertex(bel * 27 * u * v * w, A[0] * w + B[0] * u + C[0] * v, A[1] * w + B[1] * u + C[1] * v)); } V.push(row); } for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) for (let j = 0; j < N - i; j++) { m.face(V[i][j], V[i + 1][j], V[i][j + 1]); if (j < N - i - 1) { m.face(V[i + 1][j], V[i + 1][j + 1], V[i][j + 1]); } } }; jib(38, 17.5, 9.0, 36, 7.8, 25, 1.2); jib(44, 17.3, 9.3, 52, 8.6, 36, 1.2); jib(50, 17.1, 9.5, 59.5, 9.0, 47, 1.0); m"
let jib_fn = "const m = new Mesh(); const N = 12; const jib = (hy, hz, ty, tz, cy, cz, bel) => { const A = [hy, hz], B = [ty, tz], C = [cy, cz]; const V = []; for (let i = 0; i <= N; i++) { const row = []; for (let j = 0; j <= N - i; j++) { const u = i / N, v = j / N, w = 1 - u - v; row.push(m.vertex(bel * 27 * u * v * w, A[0] * w + B[0] * u + C[0] * v, A[1] * w + B[1] * u + C[1] * v)); } V.push(row); } for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) for (let j = 0; j < N - i; j++) { m.face(V[i][j], V[i + 1][j], V[i][j + 1]); if (j < N - i - 1) { m.face(V[i + 1][j], V[i + 1][j + 1], V[i][j + 1]); } } };"
def jb(tag, hy, hz, ty, tz, cy, cz, bel, pa, pb, pc)
  jb{tag}_s = poly.script@1(code="${jib_fn} jib(${hy}, ${hz}, ${ty}, ${tz}, ${cy}, ${cz}, ${bel}); m", budget=2000)
  jb{tag}_p = sim.program@1(jb{tag}_s, rate=30, values="pa=${pa}; pb=${pb}; pc=${pc}", source="${jib_src}")
  jb{tag}_m = solid.material@1(jb{tag}_p, color=[0.9, 0.86, 0.74], metallic=0.0, roughness=1.0)
  jb{tag}_f = solid.finish@1(jb{tag}_m, sheen=0.35, translucency=0.3)
  output jib_{tag} = jb{tag}_f
end
jb("1", 38, 17.5, 9.0, 36, 7.8, 25, 1.2, 18.5, 29, 1207.1)
jb("2", 44, 17.3, 9.3, 52, 8.6, 36, 1.2, 34.7, 34.7, 2122.2)
jb("3", 50, 17.1, 9.5, 59.5, 9.0, 47, 1.0, 42.4, 40.5, 2806.7)
let spanker_code = "const m = new Mesh(); const NS = 14, NV = 10; const T = [-19.9, 9], C = [-31.5, 9], P = [-29.8, 28.5], H = [-19.9, 23.5]; const g = []; for (let iv = 0; iv <= NV; iv++) { const v = iv / NV, row = []; for (let is = 0; is <= NS; is++) { const s = is / NS; const z = (T[0] + (C[0] - T[0]) * s) * (1 - v) + (H[0] + (P[0] - H[0]) * s) * v, y = (T[1] + (C[1] - T[1]) * s) * (1 - v) + (H[1] + (P[1] - H[1]) * s) * v; row.push(m.vertex(0.9 * Math.sin(Math.PI * s) * Math.sin(Math.PI * v), y, z)); } g.push(row); } for (let iv = 0; iv < NV; iv++) for (let is = 0; is < NS; is++) { m.face(g[iv][is], g[iv][is + 1], g[iv + 1][is + 1], g[iv + 1][is]); } m"
spanker_s = poly.script@1(code="${spanker_code}", budget=3000)
spanker_p = sim.program@1(spanker_s, rate=30, source="${span_src}")
spanker_m = solid.material@1(spanker_p, color=[0.9, 0.86, 0.74], metallic=0.0, roughness=1.0)
spanker_f = solid.finish@1(spanker_m, sheen=0.35, translucency=0.3)
output spanker = spanker_f

# ================= ON DECK =================
def bxs(tag, sx, sy, sz, px, py, pz, cr, cg, cb, met, rgh)
  q{tag}_b = solid.box@1(size=[{sx}, {sy}, {sz}])
  q{tag}_a = xform.move@1(q{tag}_b, by=[{px}, {py}, {pz}])
  q{tag}_m = solid.material@1(q{tag}_a, color=[{cr}, {cg}, {cb}], metallic={met}, roughness={rgh})
  q{tag}_h = anim.parent@1(q{tag}_m, parent="hull")
  output {tag} = q{tag}_h
end
# the helm on the quarterdeck: a wheel (a ring and four spokes) facing aft, and the binnacle in front of it
wheel_t = solid.torus@1(major=0.6, minor=0.045, segments=32, tube_segments=8)
wheel_r = xform.rotate@1(wheel_t, angles=[90, 0, 0])
spoke_b = solid.box@1(size=[1.3, 0.07, 0.07])
spoke_1 = xform.move@1(spoke_b, by=[0, 0, 0])
spoke_2 = xform.rotate@1(spoke_b, angles=[0, 0, 45])
spoke_3 = xform.rotate@1(spoke_b, angles=[0, 0, 90])
spoke_4 = xform.rotate@1(spoke_b, angles=[0, 0, 135])
wheel_u = solid.union@1(wheel_r, spoke_1, spoke_2, spoke_3, spoke_4)
wheel_at = xform.move@1(wheel_u, by=[0, 7.45, -14.0])
wheel_m = solid.material@1(wheel_at, color=[0.35, 0.22, 0.1], roughness=0.7)
wheel_h = anim.parent@1(wheel_m, parent="hull")
output helm = wheel_h
bxs("binnacle", 0.6, 0.9, 0.6, 0, 6.75, -15.1, 0.2, 0.12, 0.06, 0.1, 0.7)
# hatch gratings in the waist, the galley funnel, the stern skylight
bxs("hatch_fore", 2.4, 0.16, 2.4, 0, 4.98, 3.0, 0.1, 0.07, 0.04, 0.0, 0.9)
bxs("hatch_aft", 2.4, 0.16, 2.4, 0, 4.98, -5.5, 0.1, 0.07, 0.04, 0.0, 0.9)
bxs("skylight", 3.0, 0.8, 1.6, 0, 6.7, -24.5, 0.28, 0.18, 0.1, 0.0, 0.7)
funnel_c = solid.cylinder@1(radius=0.32, height=2.4, segments=16)
funnel_at = xform.move@1(funnel_c, by=[0, 6.1, 10.0])
funnel_m = solid.material@1(funnel_at, color=[0.03, 0.03, 0.035], metallic=0.5, roughness=0.6)
funnel_h = anim.parent@1(funnel_m, parent="hull")
output galley_funnel = funnel_h
# two ship's boats on the booms amidships: upturned hulls (the top half of a long ellipsoid)
boat_s = solid.sphere@1(radius=1.0, segments=24)
boat_e = xform.scale@1(boat_s, by=[1.5, 0.8, 4.4])
boat_cut_b = solid.box@1(size=[6, 3, 12])
boat_cut_a = xform.move@1(boat_cut_b, by=[0, 1.5, 0])
boat_h = solid.intersect@1(boat_e, boat_cut_a)
boat_1 = xform.move@1(boat_h, by=[0, 5.5, -2.3])
boat_2 = xform.move@1(boat_h, by=[0, 5.5, 7.2])
boat_u = solid.union@1(boat_1, boat_2)
boat_m = solid.material@1(boat_u, color=[0.62, 0.5, 0.32], roughness=0.8)
boat_h2 = anim.parent@1(boat_m, parent="hull")
output boats = boat_h2
# the windlass on the forecastle
wind_c = solid.cylinder@1(radius=0.38, height=3.2, segments=16)
wind_r = xform.rotate@1(wind_c, angles=[0, 0, 90])
wind_at = xform.move@1(wind_r, by=[0, 7.0, 25.0])
wind_m = solid.material@1(wind_at, color=[0.3, 0.2, 0.1], roughness=0.8)
wind_h = anim.parent@1(wind_m, parent="hull")
output windlass = wind_h
# stern lanterns, lit
lan_s = solid.sphere@1(radius=0.36, segments=14)
lan_l = xform.move@1(lan_s, by=[3.6, 8.7, -28.6])
lan_r = xform.move@1(lan_s, by=[-3.6, 8.7, -28.6])
lan_u = solid.union@1(lan_l, lan_r)
lan_m = solid.material@1(lan_u, color=[1, 0.82, 0.5], roughness=0.3, emissive=[5, 3.4, 1.6])
lan_h = anim.parent@1(lan_m, parent="hull")
output lanterns = lan_h

# ================= THE SEA AND THE FLOAT =================
# the sea: a grid driven by three travelling waves (the armada's), mean level y = 2 so the studio floor stays under the troughs
# the sea: the three travelling sine waves of the armada (kept as they were); only the surface below was improved
sea_g = poly.grid@1(width=400, height=400, columns=140, rows=140)
sea_r = xform.rotate@1(sea_g, angles=[-90, 0, 0])
sea_up = xform.move@1(sea_r, by=[0, 2, 0])
sea_p = sim.program@1(sea_up, rate=30, source="sim ocean\ninput mesh sea\nstate pos: vec3[sea]\nkernel wave each i in pos {\n  let r = rest(sea, i)\n  let x = r.x\n  let z = r.z\n  let h = 0.9 * sin(0.21 * x + 0.13 * z - 0.9 * t) + 0.5 * sin(-0.11 * x + 0.27 * z - 1.3 * t + 1.7) + 0.22 * sin(0.43 * x + 0.37 * z - 2.1 * t + 0.6)\n  pos[i] = vec3(x, r.y + h, z)\n}\nschedule wave\noutput mesh pos\n")
sea_m = solid.material@1(sea_p, color=[0.04, 0.17, 0.26], roughness=0.45, metallic=0.0)
output sea = sea_m
# the carrier: a small dynamic body hidden inside the hull at the waterline. Every part above is parented to it ("hull"), and so are the cloth sails' pinned vertices.
carrier_b = solid.box@1(size=[1.2, 1.2, 1.2])
carrier_m = solid.material@1(carrier_b, color=[0.3, 0.2, 0.1], roughness=0.8)
carrier = phys.body@1(carrier_m, kind="dynamic", density=0.5, linear_damping=0.15, angular_damping=2.0)
output hull = carrier
# buoyancy: the carrier is pushed toward the height of the SAME three waves the sea shows (spring and damper, gravity cancelled)
buoy = sim.program@1(size=0.03, rate=60, source="sim buoyancy\nparam spring = 7.0\nparam damp = 3.2\nparam gravity = 9.8\ninput bone hull\nstate probe: vec3[1]\nstate push: vec3[1]\nstate last: vec3[1]\nkernel feel each i in probe {\n  let c = bone_point(hull, vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0))\n  let h = 2.0 + 0.9 * sin(0.21 * c.x + 0.13 * c.z - 0.9 * t) + 0.5 * sin(-0.11 * c.x + 0.27 * c.z - 1.3 * t + 1.7) + 0.22 * sin(0.43 * c.x + 0.37 * c.z - 2.1 * t + 0.6)\n  let vy = clamp((c.y - last[i].y) / dt, -12.0, 12.0)\n  let err = clamp(h - c.y, -2.5, 2.5)\n  probe[i] = c\n  last[i] = c\n  push[i] = vec3(0.0, clamp((gravity + spring * err - damp * vy) * dt, -0.2, 0.3), 0.0)\n}\nschedule feel\noutput particles probe\noutput push hull push\n")
buoy_m = solid.material@1(buoy, color=[1, 1, 0.2], roughness=0.5)
output hull_probe = buoy_m
# in the game layer the ship is a model spawned at the waterline of the sea (y = 2)
kind_ship = game.kind@1(name="frigate", size=30, part="hull", tags=["ship"])
ship1 = game.spawn@1(kind="frigate", at=[0, 2, 0], heading=0)
rules = game.collect@1(kind_ship, ship1, name="frigate_game")
output rules = rules

# =====================================================================================================================================================
# ================================================================ THE HARBOUR ========================================================================
# =====================================================================================================================================================
# Layout (metres; the frigate is at the origin, bow +z, mean sea level y = 2): the quay face is the plane x = -9 and its top y = 4.3 (2.3 m above the mean sea, so the 1.6 m crests never wet the
# plaza); the plaza runs from x = -10 to -52; the town stands behind it (x -52 to -76); then the land rises into hills. The mole stands out at x = +70, the jetty runs from the quay at z = -70.
let qy = "4.3"
# the height of the land at (x, z): flat as the plaza and town (4.3), rising inland into noisy hills, and up toward the flanks of the bay
let land_h = "inl = clamp((0.0 - x - 52.0) / 240.0, 0.0, 1.0); rise = 62.0 * pow(inl, 1.6); side = smoothstep(120.0, 230.0, abs(z)) * 28.0 * smoothstep(40.0, 160.0, 0.0 - x); nz = (perlin(vec3(x * 0.012, 3.0, z * 0.012), 2.0) * 9.0 + perlin(vec3(x * 0.04, 5.0, z * 0.04), 4.0) * 2.5) * smoothstep(0.0, 0.35, inl); mt = 110.0 * smoothstep(250.0, 1200.0, 0.0 - x) + 70.0 * smoothstep(260.0, 1200.0, abs(z)) * smoothstep(0.0, 300.0, 0.0 - x) + 26.0 * perlin(vec3(x * 0.004, 7.0, z * 0.004), 6.0) * smoothstep(150.0, 700.0, 0.0 - x); dip = smoothstep(250.0, 300.0, abs(z)) * (1.0 - smoothstep(-200.0, -60.0, x)); h = mix(${qy} + rise + side + nz + mt, 1.0, dip);"

# ---- the land: ONE surface from the quay edge (x = -9) back to the far mountains (x = -1500) and out to the flanks (z = +-1200), its grid dense near the town (2 to 4 m cells) and coarse far away
# (20 m), because x and z are powers of u and v; the same height formula places the trees. Its own grass-and-dry-earth texture. ----
h_land = poly.surface_expr@1(code="w = v * 2.0 - 1.0; x = -9.0 - (u * 30.0 + pow(u, 2.2) * 1461.0); z = sign(w) * (abs(w) * 40.0 + pow(abs(w), 2.0) * 1160.0); ${land_h} out = vec3(x, h, z);", columns=170, rows=170, flip=false)
h_land_m = solid.material@1(h_land, color=[0.4, 0.45, 0.24], roughness=0.95)
h_land_t = solid.texture@1(h_land_m, tile=14, size="512", program="n = fbm(scale_x=7, scale_y=7, iterations=5); m = fbm(scale_x=2, scale_y=2, iterations=3); g = colorize(n, gradient=[0:#3f4d22, 0.5:#66703a, 1:#8c8648]); d = colorize(m, gradient=[0:#ffffff, 1:#d8c8a0]); albedo = blend(d, g, m, blend_type=multiply, amount=0.4); roughness = n; height = n")
output land = h_land_t

# ---- the quay wall: a stone face from below the water to the coping, with the same masonry tiled along its whole length, and the coping on top ----
let stone = "b = bricks(rows=8, columns=3, row_offset=0.5, mortar=0.05, bevel=0.15); n = fbm(scale_x=5, scale_y=5, iterations=4); stonec = colorize(b, gradient=[0:#2e2a26, 0.5:#2e2a26, 0.52:#7d776c, 1:#a8a194]); tint = colorize(n, gradient=[0:#b9b0a0, 1:#ffffff]); albedo = blend(tint, stonec, n, blend_type=multiply, amount=0.5); height = b; roughness = colorize(b, gradient=[0:#f0f0f0, 1:#d8d8d8])"
h_wall_b = solid.box@1(size=[1.2, 7.28, 524])
h_wall_a = xform.move@1(h_wall_b, by=[-9.6, 0.64, 0])
h_wall_m = solid.material@1(h_wall_a, color=[0.5, 0.48, 0.44], roughness=0.9)
h_wall_t = solid.texture@1(h_wall_m, tile=3, size="512", program="${stone}")
output quay_wall = h_wall_t
h_cope_b = solid.box@1(size=[1.2, 0.34, 524])
h_cope_a = xform.move@1(h_cope_b, by=[-9.55, 4.27, 0])
h_cope_m = solid.material@1(h_cope_a, color=[0.66, 0.63, 0.57], roughness=0.85)
h_cope_t = solid.texture@1(h_cope_m, tile=2, size="512", program="${stone}")
output quay_coping = h_cope_t
# ---- the plaza: cobbles laid on the land between the quay and the town (irregular setts, dark mortar) ----
h_cob_b = solid.box@1(size=[42, 0.1, 380])
h_cob_a = xform.move@1(h_cob_b, by=[-31, 4.32, 0])
h_cob_m = solid.material@1(h_cob_a, color=[0.5, 0.47, 0.42], roughness=0.85)
h_cob_t = solid.texture@1(h_cob_m, tile=6, size="512", program="b = bricks_uneven4(x=12, y=12, randomness=0.6, mortar=0.12, bevel=0.25); n = fbm(scale_x=6, scale_y=6, iterations=4); c = colorize(b, gradient=[0:#25221e, 0.04:#25221e, 0.1:#6c665c, 1:#a59d8e]); t = colorize(n, gradient=[0:#c8bca8, 1:#ffffff]); albedo = blend(t, c, n, blend_type=multiply, amount=0.5); height = b; roughness = colorize(b, gradient=[0:#f0f0f0, 1:#d0d0d0])")
output plaza = h_cob_t

# =============================================== THE TOWN ===============================================
# One small builder (JavaScript, run once per material) makes every house from a table [z, width, floors, depth, wall palette, roof kind, shutter colour]: the facades, the gabled roofs, the
# windows (dark glass, and the lit ones, chosen by a fixed hash so the same windows glow every time), the shutters, sills, doors and chimneys, plus the customs house with its portico, clock tower
# and spire. Facades face +x (the quay) at x = -52. A handful of meshes grouped by material, not an output per house.
let town = "const Q = 4.3, FX = -52, FH = 3.2; const H = [[-124,10,4,13,0,0,0],[-112.85,9.5,3,12,1,1,1],[-101.2,11,5,14,2,0,0],[-89.3,10,4,13,3,2,1],[-78.4,9,3,12,4,0,0],[-61,10,4,14,5,1,1],[-49.1,11,5,13,0,2,0],[-37.45,9.5,3,12,2,0,1],[-26.3,10,4,15,1,1,0],[23.75,9.5,4,13,3,0,1],[34.9,10,3,12,5,2,0],[46.8,11,5,14,4,0,1],[58.45,9.5,4,13,0,1,0],[69.6,10,3,12,2,2,1],[81.5,11,4,15,1,0,0],[93.15,9.5,5,13,3,1,1],[104.3,10,3,12,5,0,0],[115.7,10,4,14,4,2,1],[125.85,7.5,3,12,0,0,1]]; const hh = (e) => e[2] * FH + 0.9; const colsOf = (e) => Math.max(2, Math.round(e[1] / 3)); const box = (m, x0, x1, y0, y1, z0, z1) => { const v = [[x0, y0, z0], [x1, y0, z0], [x1, y1, z0], [x0, y1, z0], [x0, y0, z1], [x1, y0, z1], [x1, y1, z1], [x0, y1, z1]].map((p) => m.vertex(p[0], p[1], p[2])); m.face(v[0], v[3], v[2], v[1]); m.face(v[4], v[5], v[6], v[7]); m.face(v[0], v[1], v[5], v[4]); m.face(v[3], v[7], v[6], v[2]); m.face(v[0], v[4], v[7], v[3]); m.face(v[1], v[2], v[6], v[5]); }; const two = (m) => (...ids) => { m.face(...ids); m.face(...ids.slice().reverse()); }; const lit = (e, r, c) => { const s = Math.sin(e[0] * 12.9898 + r * 78.233 + c * 37.719) * 43758.5453; return s - Math.floor(s) > 0.55; }; function facades(p) { const m = new Mesh(); for (const e of H) if (e[4] === p) box(m, FX - e[3], FX, Q, Q + hh(e), e[0] - e[1] / 2, e[0] + e[1] / 2); return m; } function roofs(k) { const m = new Mesh(); const f = two(m); for (const e of H) { if (e[5] !== k) continue; const w = e[1], d = e[3], z = e[0], hw = w / 2 + 0.4, rh = Math.min(5, w * 0.45), y0 = Q + hh(e), x0 = FX - d - 0.4, x1 = FX + 0.5; const a0 = m.vertex(x0, y0, z - hw), a1 = m.vertex(x1, y0, z - hw), b0 = m.vertex(x0, y0, z + hw), b1 = m.vertex(x1, y0, z + hw), r0 = m.vertex(x0, y0 + rh, z), r1 = m.vertex(x1, y0 + rh, z); f(a0, a1, r1, r0); f(b0, r0, r1, b1); f(a0, r0, b0); f(a1, b1, r1); f(a0, b0, b1, a1); } return m; } function windows(kind) { const m = new Mesh(); for (const e of H) { const C = colsOf(e); for (let r = 0; r < e[2]; r++) for (let c = 0; c < C; c++) { if (r === 0 && c === C - 1) continue; const zc = e[0] - e[1] / 2 + (c + 0.5) * e[1] / C, yc = Q + 1.9 + r * FH, on = lit(e, r, c); if (kind === 0 && !on) box(m, FX, FX + 0.1, yc - 0.8, yc + 0.8, zc - 0.5, zc + 0.5); if (kind === 1 && on) box(m, FX, FX + 0.1, yc - 0.8, yc + 0.8, zc - 0.5, zc + 0.5); if (kind === 2 || kind === 3) { if (e[6] === kind - 2) { box(m, FX, FX + 0.09, yc - 0.8, yc + 0.8, zc - 0.96, zc - 0.54); box(m, FX, FX + 0.09, yc - 0.8, yc + 0.8, zc + 0.54, zc + 0.96); } } if (kind === 4) { box(m, FX, FX + 0.28, yc - 0.88, yc - 0.8, zc - 0.66, zc + 0.66); box(m, FX, FX + 0.14, yc + 0.8, yc + 0.95, zc - 0.62, zc + 0.62); } } } if (kind === 0) { for (let k = 0; k < 7; k++) for (const y of [Q + 3.1, Q + 7.4]) box(m, FX, FX + 0.1, y - 1.1, y + 1.1, -12 + 4 * k - 0.7, -12 + 4 * k + 0.7); box(m, FX, FX + 0.1, Q + 15, Q + 18.5, -1.2, 1.2); } return m; } function doors() { const m = new Mesh(); for (const e of H) box(m, FX, FX + 0.13, Q, Q + 2.5, e[0] + e[1] / 2 - 1.9, e[0] + e[1] / 2 - 0.7); box(m, FX + 1.5, FX + 1.7, Q, Q + 5.2, -1.8, 1.8); return m; } function chimneys() { const m = new Mesh(); for (const e of H) { const y = Q + hh(e) + Math.min(5, e[1] * 0.45) * 0.3; box(m, FX - e[3] * 0.7 - 0.55, FX - e[3] * 0.7 + 0.55, y, y + 2.8, e[0] + e[1] * 0.2 - 0.55, e[0] + e[1] * 0.2 + 0.55); } return m; } const CD = 18, CW = 17; function cbody() { const m = new Mesh(); box(m, FX - CD, FX, Q, Q + 11, -CW, CW); box(m, FX - CD - 0.4, FX + 0.5, Q, Q + 1.1, -CW - 0.5, CW + 0.5); box(m, FX - CD - 0.3, FX + 0.4, Q + 10.4, Q + 11.2, -CW - 0.4, CW + 0.4); box(m, FX - 7, FX, Q + 11, Q + 25, -3.5, 3.5); box(m, FX - 7.3, FX + 0.3, Q + 24.2, Q + 25.2, -3.8, 3.8); return m; } function croof() { const m = new Mesh(); const f = two(m); const x0 = FX - CD - 0.8, x1 = FX + 0.8, z0 = -CW - 0.8, z1 = CW + 0.8, y = Q + 11.1, xm = (x0 + x1) / 2; const A = m.vertex(x0, y, z0), B = m.vertex(x1, y, z0), C = m.vertex(x1, y, z1), D = m.vertex(x0, y, z1), R0 = m.vertex(xm, y + 5.5, z0 + 8), R1 = m.vertex(xm, y + 5.5, z1 - 8); f(B, C, R1, R0); f(D, A, R0, R1); f(A, B, R0); f(C, D, R1); return m; } function spire() { const m = new Mesh(); const f = two(m); const y = Q + 25.2, cx = FX - 3.5; const A = m.vertex(cx - 3.9, y, -3.9), B = m.vertex(cx + 3.9, y, -3.9), C = m.vertex(cx + 3.9, y, 3.9), D = m.vertex(cx - 3.9, y, 3.9), T = m.vertex(cx, y + 11, 0); f(A, B, T); f(B, C, T); f(C, D, T); f(D, A, T); return m; } function portico() { const m = new Mesh(); for (let k = 0; k < 9; k++) { const z = -12 + 3 * k, n = 10; const a = [], b = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const t = 2 * Math.PI * i / n, x = FX + 2.2 + 0.45 * Math.cos(t), zz = z + 0.45 * Math.sin(t); a.push(m.vertex(x, Q + 0.5, zz)); b.push(m.vertex(x, Q + 9.5, zz)); } for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const j = (i + 1) % n; m.face(a[i], a[j], b[j], b[i]); } } box(m, FX + 1.5, FX + 3.0, Q + 9.5, Q + 10.8, -13.5, 13.5); box(m, FX + 0.4, FX + 4.0, Q, Q + 0.5, -14.5, 14.5); const f = two(m); const p0 = m.vertex(FX + 1.5, Q + 10.8, -13.5), p1 = m.vertex(FX + 1.5, Q + 10.8, 13.5), p2 = m.vertex(FX + 1.5, Q + 13.6, 0), q0 = m.vertex(FX + 3.0, Q + 10.8, -13.5), q1 = m.vertex(FX + 3.0, Q + 10.8, 13.5), q2 = m.vertex(FX + 3.0, Q + 13.6, 0); f(p0, p1, p2); f(q0, q2, q1); f(p0, q0, q2, p2); f(p1, p2, q2, q1); return m; } function clock() { const m = new Mesh(); box(m, FX, FX + 0.15, Q + 19.4, Q + 22.6, -1.6, 1.6); for (const s of [-1, 1]) box(m, FX - 5.4, FX - 1.6, Q + 19.4, Q + 22.6, s * 3.5, s * 3.65); return m; }"
# wall palettes: a plaster colour (light to dark) per kind of house (hex without the # in the call: a # in a call's argument starts a comment)
def wall(p, c0, c1)
  tw{p}_s = poly.script@1(code="${town} facades(${p})")
  tw{p}_m = solid.material@1(tw${p}_s, color=[0.85, 0.78, 0.65], roughness=0.9)
  tw{p}_t = solid.texture@1(tw${p}_m, tile=5, size="256", program="n = fbm(scale_x=5, scale_y=5, iterations=5); s = fbm(scale_x=2, scale_y=10, iterations=3); c = colorize(n, gradient=[0:#${c0}, 1:#${c1}]); d = colorize(s, gradient=[0:#ffffff, 1:#cfc6b4]); albedo = blend(d, c, s, blend_type=multiply, amount=0.35); roughness = n; height = s")
  output town_wall_{p} = tw${p}_t
end
wall(0, "e3bb70", "c99a52")
wall(1, "dc8d62", "bb6c44")
wall(2, "f1e6cb", "d8c8a2")
wall(3, "a7bd98", "80987a")
wall(4, "e0a6a2", "c5827f")
wall(5, "adc8dc", "88a8c4")
# a plaster part of the customs house, and the roofs (tiles or slate: courses with dark joints, a little mottling)
def plaster(name, call, c0, c1)
  {name}_s = poly.script@1(code="${town} ${call}")
  {name}_m = solid.material@1(${name}_s, color=[0.9, 0.85, 0.72], roughness=0.9)
  {name}_t = solid.texture@1(${name}_m, tile=5, size="256", program="n = fbm(scale_x=5, scale_y=5, iterations=5); s = fbm(scale_x=2, scale_y=10, iterations=3); c = colorize(n, gradient=[0:#${c0}, 1:#${c1}]); d = colorize(s, gradient=[0:#ffffff, 1:#cfc6b4]); albedo = blend(d, c, s, blend_type=multiply, amount=0.35); roughness = n; height = s")
end
def roofm(name, call, c0, c1)
  {name}_s = poly.script@1(code="${town} ${call}")
  {name}_m = solid.material@1(${name}_s, color=[0.5, 0.3, 0.2], roughness=0.8)
  {name}_t = solid.texture@1(${name}_m, tile=3, size="256", program="b = bricks(rows=16, columns=12, row_offset=0.5, mortar=0.07, bevel=0.1); n = fbm(scale_x=4, scale_y=4, iterations=4); c = colorize(b, gradient=[0:#1c1410, 0.05:#1c1410, 0.1:#${c1}, 1:#${c0}]); k = colorize(n, gradient=[0:#ffffff, 1:#b8b0a4]); albedo = blend(k, c, n, blend_type=multiply, amount=0.4); height = b; roughness = colorize(b, gradient=[0:#f0f0f0, 1:#c8c8c8])")
end
roofm("rf0", "roofs(0)", "bf5f38", "8c3d24")
roofm("rf1", "roofs(1)", "6c747e", "464d56")
roofm("rf2", "roofs(2)", "9a3a2c", "5e2219")
output town_roof_0 = rf0_t
output town_roof_1 = rf1_t
output town_roof_2 = rf2_t
# windows, shutters (two colours), sills, doors, chimneys: each ONE mesh for the whole town
h_gl = poly.script@1(code="${town} windows(0)")
h_gl_m = solid.material@1(h_gl, color=[0.05, 0.07, 0.1], metallic=0.2, roughness=0.08)
output town_glass = h_gl_m
h_lt = poly.script@1(code="${town} windows(1)")
h_lt_m = solid.material@1(h_lt, color=[0.95, 0.75, 0.45], roughness=0.3, emissive=[3.0, 1.9, 0.8])
output town_lit_windows = h_lt_m
h_sa = poly.script@1(code="${town} windows(2)")
h_sa_m = solid.material@1(h_sa, color=[0.2, 0.36, 0.3], roughness=0.7)
output shutters_green = h_sa_m
h_sb = poly.script@1(code="${town} windows(3)")
h_sb_m = solid.material@1(h_sb, color=[0.52, 0.2, 0.16], roughness=0.7)
output shutters_red = h_sb_m
h_sl = poly.script@1(code="${town} windows(4)")
h_sl_m = solid.material@1(h_sl, color=[0.78, 0.74, 0.66], roughness=0.85)
output sills = h_sl_m
h_dr = poly.script@1(code="${town} doors()")
h_dr_m = solid.material@1(h_dr, color=[0.2, 0.12, 0.07], roughness=0.75)
output doors = h_dr_m
h_ch = poly.script@1(code="${town} chimneys()")
h_ch_m = solid.material@1(h_ch, color=[0.55, 0.3, 0.22], roughness=0.9)
output chimneys = h_ch_m
# the customs house: cream plaster body and clock tower, slate hip roof, a copper spire, a white portico, glowing clock faces
plaster("cs_body", "cbody()", "ede0c0", "d0c19a")
output customs_house = cs_body_t
roofm("cs_roof", "croof()", "6c747e", "464d56")
output customs_roof = cs_roof_t
h_sp = poly.script@1(code="${town} spire()")

output customs_spire = h_sp_m
plaster("cs_por", "portico()", "f2ecde", "d8d0bc")
output customs_portico = cs_por_t
h_ck = poly.script@1(code="${town} clock()")
h_ck_m = solid.material@1(h_ck, color=[1, 0.95, 0.8], roughness=0.4, emissive=[2.6, 2.3, 1.6])
output customs_clock = h_ck_m

# =============================================== THE WORKING PORT ===============================================
# Small builders (JavaScript, run once per material). jsp: shared helpers (a hash, a yawed box, a frustum, all two-sided so winding never matters for these small props).
let jsp = "const TAU = Math.PI * 2; const Q = 4.3; const hash = (n) => { const s = Math.sin(n * 12.9898 + 4.1414) * 43758.5453; return s - Math.floor(s); }; const two = (m) => (...ids) => { m.face(...ids); m.face(...ids.slice().reverse()); }; const boxY = (m, cx, cy, cz, sx, sy, sz, yaw) => { const f = two(m), c = Math.cos(yaw), s = Math.sin(yaw), v = []; for (const dy of [-0.5, 0.5]) for (const q of [[-0.5, -0.5], [0.5, -0.5], [0.5, 0.5], [-0.5, 0.5]]) { const lx = q[0] * sx, lz = q[1] * sz; v.push(m.vertex(cx + lx * c + lz * s, cy + dy * sy, cz - lx * s + lz * c)); } f(v[0], v[1], v[2], v[3]); f(v[4], v[5], v[6], v[7]); f(v[0], v[1], v[5], v[4]); f(v[1], v[2], v[6], v[5]); f(v[2], v[3], v[7], v[6]); f(v[3], v[0], v[4], v[7]); }; const cyl = (m, x, z, y0, y1, r0, r1, n) => { const f = two(m), a = [], b = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const t = TAU * i / n; a.push(m.vertex(x + r0 * Math.cos(t), y0, z + r0 * Math.sin(t))); b.push(m.vertex(x + r1 * Math.cos(t), y1, z + r1 * Math.sin(t))); } for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const j = (i + 1) % n; f(a[i], a[j], b[j], b[i]); } f(...a); f(...b); };"
# the quay furniture: bollards every 8 m along the coping, lamp posts every 24 m (poles, glass), cargo piles (crates, barrels, sacks)
let jq = "function bollards() { const m = new Mesh(); for (let k = 0; k < 33; k++) { const z = -128 + 8 * k; cyl(m, -9.55, z, Q + 0.14, Q + 0.62, 0.2, 0.17, 10); cyl(m, -9.55, z, Q + 0.62, Q + 0.8, 0.3, 0.3, 10); } return m; } function lampPoles() { const m = new Mesh(); for (let k = 0; k < 11; k++) { const z = -120 + 24 * k; cyl(m, -14, z, Q, Q + 0.7, 0.24, 0.16, 8); cyl(m, -14, z, Q + 0.7, Q + 5.4, 0.11, 0.08, 8); cyl(m, -14, z, Q + 5.4, Q + 5.6, 0.3, 0.3, 8); cyl(m, -14, z, Q + 6.4, Q + 6.7, 0.42, 0.05, 4); } return m; } function lampGlass() { const m = new Mesh(); for (let k = 0; k < 11; k++) boxY(m, -14, Q + 6.0, -120 + 24 * k, 0.5, 0.78, 0.5, 0.78); return m; } function cargo(kind) { const m = new Mesh(); const crate = [[-20, 26], [-19, -33], [-21, 72], [-24, -92], [-22, 104]], barrel = [[-17, 33], [-23, -38], [-18, 80], [-20, -100], [-17.5, 112]], sack = [[-22, 30.5], [-17.5, -37], [-24, 76], [-21.5, 96]]; if (kind === 0) for (const p of crate) { for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) for (let j = 0; j < 2; j++) boxY(m, p[0] + i * 1.3, Q + 0.55, p[1] + j * 1.3, 1.15, 1.1, 1.15, hash(p[1] + i * 3 + j) * 0.5); boxY(m, p[0] + 0.65, Q + 1.65, p[1] + 0.3, 1.1, 1.1, 1.1, hash(p[0]) * 0.6); boxY(m, p[0] + 0.65, Q + 1.65, p[1] + 1.6, 1.1, 1.1, 1.1, hash(p[0] + 1) * 0.6); boxY(m, p[0] + 0.65, Q + 2.75, p[1] + 0.95, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.3); } if (kind === 1) for (const p of barrel) for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { const a = i % 3, b = Math.floor(i / 3); cyl(m, p[0] + a * 0.95 + b * 0.45, p[1] + b * 0.85, Q, Q + 0.95, 0.4, 0.4, 10); } if (kind === 2) for (const p of sack) for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { const a = i % 3, b = Math.floor(i / 3); cyl(m, p[0] + a * 0.8 + b * 0.4, p[1] + b * 0.7, Q, Q + 0.55, 0.42, 0.3, 8); } return m; }"
# the harbour crane, left of the frigate's stern: a lattice tower, and a lattice jib with counter-jib, pylon, stays and a hook, which slews slowly (the jib is its own part)
let jc = "const CX = -15, CZ = -58; function craneTower() { const m = new Mesh(); const legs = [[-1, -1], [1, -1], [1, 1], [-1, 1]]; const at = (l, f) => [CX + l[0] * (2.0 - f), Q + 17 * f, CZ + l[1] * (2.0 - f)]; for (const l of legs) rope(m, at(l, 0), at(l, 1), 0.17, 6); for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) { const f0 = k / 4, f1 = (k + 1) / 4; for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const a = legs[i], b = legs[(i + 1) % 4]; rope(m, at(a, f1), at(b, f1), 0.07, 4); rope(m, at(a, f0), at(b, f1), 0.05, 4); rope(m, at(b, f0), at(a, f1), 0.05, 4); } } return m; } function craneJib() { const m = new Mesh(); boxY(m, CX, Q + 17.6, CZ, 2.6, 1.4, 2.6, 0); const L = 24, N = 10; const lo = (t, s) => [CX + t * L, Q + 18.2 + t * 2.6, CZ + s * 0.55], tp = (t) => [CX + t * L, Q + 19.6 + t * 2.0, CZ]; for (let k = 0; k < N; k++) { const t0 = k / N, t1 = (k + 1) / N; for (const s of [-1, 1]) { rope(m, lo(t0, s), lo(t1, s), 0.08, 4); rope(m, lo(t0, s), tp(t1), 0.04, 4); rope(m, tp(t0), lo(t1, s), 0.04, 4); } rope(m, tp(t0), tp(t1), 0.07, 4); rope(m, lo(t0, -1), lo(t0, 1), 0.04, 4); } for (const s of [-1, 1]) rope(m, [CX, Q + 18.2, CZ + s * 0.55], [CX - 9, Q + 18.0, CZ + s * 0.55], 0.08, 4); rope(m, [CX, Q + 19.6, CZ], [CX - 9, Q + 18.2, CZ], 0.07, 4); boxY(m, CX - 8.5, Q + 17.3, CZ, 3.2, 2.0, 2.0, 0); const apex = [CX, Q + 27, CZ]; rope(m, [CX, Q + 19, CZ], apex, 0.12, 4); rope(m, apex, tp(1), 0.05, 4); rope(m, apex, tp(0.5), 0.05, 4); rope(m, apex, [CX - 9, Q + 18.2, CZ], 0.05, 4); const tx = CX + 0.82 * L; rope(m, [tx, Q + 17.9 + 0.82 * 2.6, CZ], [tx, Q + 8.5, CZ], 0.03, 4); boxY(m, tx, Q + 8.2, CZ, 0.5, 0.6, 0.5, 0); return m; }"
# the mole: a stone breakwater (core and parapet), its armour of rocks on the seaward side, the lighthouse at its end, and the jetty with its piles
let jm = "const LX = 70, LZ = 118; function mole() { const m = new Mesh(); boxY(m, LX, 1.6, 24, 9, 8, 188, 0); for (let k = 0; k < 16; k++) boxY(m, LX + 4.4, 6.3, -64 + 12 * k, 1.1, 1.4, 12, 0); cyl(m, LX, LZ, 5.6, 7.6, 4.8, 4.2, 16); return m; } function rocks() { const m = new Mesh(); const g = (1 + Math.sqrt(5)) / 2; const V = [[-1, g, 0], [1, g, 0], [-1, -g, 0], [1, -g, 0], [0, -1, g], [0, 1, g], [0, -1, -g], [0, 1, -g], [g, 0, -1], [g, 0, 1], [-g, 0, -1], [-g, 0, 1]]; const F = [[0, 11, 5], [0, 5, 1], [0, 1, 7], [0, 7, 10], [0, 10, 11], [1, 5, 9], [5, 11, 4], [11, 10, 2], [10, 7, 6], [7, 1, 8], [3, 9, 4], [3, 4, 2], [3, 2, 6], [3, 6, 8], [3, 8, 9], [4, 9, 5], [2, 4, 11], [6, 2, 10], [8, 6, 7], [9, 8, 1]]; const rock = (cx, cy, cz, rx, ry, rz, s) => { const ids = V.map((v, i) => { const k = 0.72 + 0.56 * hash(s * 7 + i), n = Math.hypot(v[0], v[1], v[2]); return m.vertex(cx + v[0] / n * rx * k, cy + v[1] / n * ry * k, cz + v[2] / n * rz * k); }); for (const f of F) m.face(ids[f[0]], ids[f[1]], ids[f[2]]); }; for (let i = 0; i < 300; i++) { const z = -70 + 190 * hash(i), l = hash(i + 500), r = 1.3 + 1.9 * hash(i + 300) * (1 - 0.4 * l); rock(LX + 5.2 + l * 7, 2.4 + (1 - l) * 2.4 + hash(i + 900) * 0.9, z, r, r * 0.75, r * 1.1, i); } for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { const a = hash(i + 2000) * TAU, d = 5 + 4 * hash(i + 2100), r = 1.4 + 1.4 * hash(i + 2200); rock(LX + d * Math.cos(a), 2.6 + hash(i + 2300) * 1.2, LZ + 3 + d * Math.sin(a), r, r * 0.7, r, i + 700); } return m; } const lr = (y) => 3.6 - (y - 7.6) / 23.4 * 1.2; function lhWhite() { const m = new Mesh(); for (const b of [[7.6, 14], [20, 26]]) cyl(m, LX, LZ, b[0], b[1], lr(b[0]), lr(b[1]), 18); return m; } function lhRed() { const m = new Mesh(); for (const b of [[14, 20], [26, 31]]) cyl(m, LX, LZ, b[0], b[1], lr(b[0]), lr(b[1]), 18); return m; } function lhDark() { const m = new Mesh(); cyl(m, LX, LZ, 31, 31.45, 4.0, 4.0, 18); for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) { const t = TAU * i / 18; cyl(m, LX + 3.8 * Math.cos(t), LZ + 3.8 * Math.sin(t), 31.45, 32.5, 0.05, 0.05, 5); } for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { const t = TAU * i / 8; cyl(m, LX + 1.9 * Math.cos(t), LZ + 1.9 * Math.sin(t), 31.45, 34.3, 0.08, 0.08, 5); } cyl(m, LX, LZ, 34.3, 34.6, 2.2, 2.2, 14); cyl(m, LX, LZ, 34.6, 36.4, 2.4, 0.1, 14); boxY(m, LX - 3.4, 9.2, LZ, 0.3, 3.2, 1.8, 0); return m; } function lhGlass() { const m = new Mesh(); cyl(m, LX, LZ, 31.45, 34.3, 1.8, 1.8, 14); return m; } function jettyDeck() { const m = new Mesh(); boxY(m, 7.5, 3.95, -70, 33, 0.22, 4.6, 0); return m; } function jettyPiles() { const m = new Mesh(); for (let k = 0; k < 12; k++) { for (const s of [-2.2, 2.2]) cyl(m, -6.5 + 2.8 * k, -70 + s, -2, 4.25, 0.22, 0.2, 8); boxY(m, -6.5 + 2.8 * k, 3.65, -70, 0.25, 0.25, 4.9, 0); } return m; }"
# gulls: a flock gliding on a ring around (cx, cz); each is a small body, wings in a shallow V, a tail. The whole flock turns slowly about the ring's centre (one animated part).
let jg = "function gulls(cx, cz, n, r0, seed) { const m = new Mesh(); const f = two(m); for (let g = 0; g < n; g++) { const a = hash(seed + g * 3) * TAU, R = r0 + hash(seed + g * 5) * 22, y = 44 + hash(seed + g * 7) * 22; const px = cx + R * Math.cos(a), pz = cz + R * Math.sin(a), tx = -Math.sin(a), tz = Math.cos(a), sx = Math.cos(a), sz = Math.sin(a), S = 0.9 + 0.5 * hash(seed + g); const V = (fx, fy, fz) => m.vertex(px + (tx * fz + sx * fx) * S, y + fy * S, pz + (tz * fz + sz * fx) * S); const nose = V(0, 0, 0.45), tail = V(0, 0, -0.45), bl = V(-0.09, 0.05, 0), br = V(0.09, 0.05, 0), bt = V(0, 0.09, -0.05), bb = V(0, -0.07, 0.05); f(nose, bl, bt); f(nose, bt, br); f(nose, bb, bl); f(nose, br, bb); f(tail, bt, bl); f(tail, br, bt); f(tail, bl, bb); f(tail, bb, br); const wl = V(-1.0, 0.12, -0.22), wr = V(1.0, 0.12, -0.22), w0l = V(-0.08, 0.04, 0.12), w0r = V(0.08, 0.04, 0.12), w1l = V(-0.08, 0.04, -0.25), w1r = V(0.08, 0.04, -0.25); f(w0l, wl, w1l); f(w0r, w1r, wr); } return m; }"
# a fishing boat in world coordinates (centre cx, cz; yaw about y in radians, the bow at yaw = 0 pointing +z; length L, beam B): part 0 the hull (a loft of sections), 1 the deck and wheelhouse, 2 mast, boom and stays, 3 the wheelhouse windows
let jb2 = "function boat(cx, cz, yaw, L, B, which) { const m = new Mesh(); const f = two(m); const cs = Math.cos(yaw), sn = Math.sin(yaw); const W = (x, z) => [cx + x * cs + z * sn, cz - x * sn + z * cs]; const P = (x, y, z) => { const w = W(x, z); return m.vertex(w[0], y, w[1]); }; const dr = 0.4 * B + 0.15, fb = 0.28 * B + 0.35; const hb = (t) => (B / 2) * (t < 0.35 ? 0.66 + 0.34 * (t / 0.35) : 1 - Math.pow((t - 0.35) / 0.65, 2.2)); const dk = (t) => dr * (t < 0.2 ? 0.72 + 0.28 * t / 0.2 : 1 - 0.9 * Math.pow((t - 0.2) / 0.8, 3)); const sh = (t) => fb + 0.55 * Math.pow(t, 3); const N = 20, WL = 2; if (which === 0) { const rows = []; for (let i = 0; i <= N; i++) { const t = i / N, z = -L / 2 + t * L, h = hb(t), d = dk(t), s = sh(t); const half = [[0, -d], [0.45 * h, -0.92 * d], [0.8 * h, -0.55 * d], [0.97 * h, -0.12 * d], [h, 0], [1.05 * h, 0.55 * s], [1.1 * h, s]]; const pts = half.slice().reverse().map((p) => [-p[0], p[1]]).concat(half.slice(1)); rows.push(pts.map((p) => P(p[0], WL + p[1], z))); } for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) for (let j = 0; j + 1 < rows[0].length; j++) f(rows[i][j], rows[i][j + 1], rows[i + 1][j + 1], rows[i + 1][j]); f(...rows[0]); } if (which === 1) { const dy = (t) => WL + sh(t) - 0.1; for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) { const t0 = i / N, t1 = (i + 1) / N, z0 = -L / 2 + t0 * L, z1 = -L / 2 + t1 * L, h0 = hb(t0) * 1.02, h1 = hb(t1) * 1.02; if (h1 < 0.02) f(P(-h0, dy(t0), z0), P(h0, dy(t0), z0), P(0, dy(t1), z1)); else f(P(-h0, dy(t0), z0), P(h0, dy(t0), z0), P(h1, dy(t1), z1), P(-h1, dy(t1), z1)); } const wc = W(0, -0.12 * L); const yb = WL + sh(0.4) - 0.1; boxY(m, wc[0], yb + 0.8, wc[1], B * 0.55, 1.6, L * 0.26, yaw); boxY(m, wc[0], yb + 1.66, wc[1], B * 0.66, 0.14, L * 0.3, yaw); } if (which === 2) { const mz = 0.2 * L, yb = WL + sh(0.62) - 0.1, a = (x, y, z) => { const w = W(x, z); return [w[0], y, w[1]]; }; rope(m, a(0, yb, mz), a(0, yb + 0.62 * L + 1.6, mz), 0.08, 6); rope(m, a(0, yb + 2.3, mz), a(0, yb + 2.2, mz - 0.38 * L), 0.05, 5); rope(m, a(0, yb + 0.62 * L + 1.5, mz), a(0, yb + 0.9, L * 0.48), 0.02, 4); rope(m, a(0, yb + 0.62 * L + 1.5, mz), a(0, yb + 0.9, -L * 0.45), 0.02, 4); } if (which === 3) { const yb = WL + sh(0.4) - 0.1; for (const s of [-1, 1]) for (const k of [-1, 0, 1]) { const w = W(s * (B * 0.275 + 0.02), -0.12 * L + k * L * 0.075); boxY(m, w[0], yb + 0.95, w[1], 0.08, 0.5, L * 0.045, yaw); } } return m; }"

# a part: a builder call, its material and its output (one macro for the dozens of small meshes below)
def part(name, code, r, g, b, met, rgh)
  {name}_s = poly.script@1(code={code})
  {name}_m = solid.material@1(${name}_s, color=[{r}, {g}, {b}], metallic={met}, roughness={rgh})
  output {name} = ${name}_m
end
def glow(name, code, r, g, b, er, eg, eb)
  {name}_s = poly.script@1(code={code})
  {name}_m = solid.material@1(${name}_s, color=[{r}, {g}, {b}], roughness=0.3, emissive=[{er}, {eg}, {eb}])
  output {name} = ${name}_m
end
# ---- the quay furniture ----
part("bollards", "${jsp} ${jq} bollards()", 0.07, 0.07, 0.08, 0.6, 0.5)
part("lamp_poles", "${jsp} ${jq} lampPoles()", 0.06, 0.07, 0.08, 0.6, 0.5)
glow("lamp_glass", "${jsp} ${jq} lampGlass()", 1.0, 0.8, 0.5, 4.5, 2.9, 1.3)
for k in 0..11
  lamp_light_{k} = light.point@1(position=[-14, 10.3, {-120 + 24 * k}], color=[1.0, 0.74, 0.42], intensity=45, range=28)
end
part("crates", "${jsp} ${jq} cargo(0)", 0.55, 0.4, 0.24, 0.0, 0.85)
part("barrels", "${jsp} ${jq} cargo(1)", 0.4, 0.26, 0.14, 0.0, 0.8)
part("sacks", "${jsp} ${jq} cargo(2)", 0.72, 0.62, 0.44, 0.0, 0.95)
# ---- the harbour crane (the jib slews slowly, 24 degrees either way every 40 s, about the tower axis) ----
part("crane_tower", "${jsrope} ${jsp} ${jc} craneTower()", 0.07, 0.1, 0.12, 0.5, 0.55)
crane_jib_s = poly.script@1(code="${jsrope} ${jsp} ${jc} craneJib()")
crane_jib_m = solid.material@1(crane_jib_s, color=[0.62, 0.12, 0.08], metallic=0.4, roughness=0.55)
crane_jib_w = anim.wave@1(crane_jib_m, property="rotation", amplitude=[0, 24, 0], period=40, pivot=[-15, 0, -58])
output crane_jib = crane_jib_w
# ---- the mole, its rocks, the lighthouse ----
h_mole_s = poly.script@1(code="${jsp} ${jm} mole()")
h_mole_m = solid.material@1(h_mole_s, color=[0.5, 0.48, 0.44], roughness=0.9)
h_mole_t = solid.texture@1(h_mole_m, tile=3, size="512", program="${stone}")
output mole = h_mole_t
h_rock_s = poly.script@1(code="${jsp} ${jm} rocks()")
h_rock_m = solid.material@1(h_rock_s, color=[0.42, 0.4, 0.37], roughness=0.95)
h_rock_t = solid.texture@1(h_rock_m, tile=6, size="256", program="n = fbm(scale_x=4, scale_y=4, iterations=5); c = colorize(n, gradient=[0:#4a463f, 0.5:#77726a, 1:#a59f92]); albedo = c; roughness = n; height = n")
output mole_rocks = h_rock_t
part("lighthouse_white", "${jsp} ${jm} lhWhite()", 0.93, 0.92, 0.88, 0.0, 0.7)
part("lighthouse_red", "${jsp} ${jm} lhRed()", 0.72, 0.14, 0.1, 0.0, 0.7)
part("lighthouse_gallery", "${jsp} ${jm} lhDark()", 0.07, 0.07, 0.08, 0.5, 0.5)
glow("lighthouse_lantern", "${jsp} ${jm} lhGlass()", 1.0, 0.9, 0.6, 6, 4.6, 2.2)
lh_light = light.point@1(position=[70, 33, 118], color=[1.0, 0.85, 0.5], intensity=900, range=90)
# ---- the jetty ----
h_jd_s = poly.script@1(code="${jsp} ${jm} jettyDeck()")
h_jd_m = solid.material@1(h_jd_s, color=[0.5, 0.38, 0.24], roughness=0.85, recipe="planks")
output jetty_deck = h_jd_m
part("jetty_piles", "${jsp} ${jm} jettyPiles()", 0.2, 0.15, 0.1, 0.0, 0.9)

# ---- fishing boats: each hull bobs and rolls on its own phase; the deck, wheelhouse, windows and mast follow the hull ----
def boat(tag, cx, cz, yaw, L, B, k, ph)
  bh_{tag}_s = poly.script@1(code="${jsrope} ${jsp} ${jb2} boat(${cx}, ${cz}, ${yaw}, ${L}, ${B}, 0)")
  if k == 0
    bh_{tag}_m = solid.material@1(bh_${tag}_s, color=[0.1, 0.2, 0.42], roughness=0.5)
  end
  if k == 1
    bh_{tag}_m = solid.material@1(bh_${tag}_s, color=[0.62, 0.15, 0.1], roughness=0.5)
  end
  if k == 2
    bh_{tag}_m = solid.material@1(bh_${tag}_s, color=[0.12, 0.34, 0.26], roughness=0.5)
  end
  if k == 3
    bh_{tag}_m = solid.material@1(bh_${tag}_s, color=[0.9, 0.86, 0.76], roughness=0.5)
  end
  bh_{tag}_p = anim.wave@1(bh_${tag}_m, property="position", amplitude=[0, 0.22, 0], period=3.7, phase={ph})
  bh_{tag}_r = anim.wave@1(bh_${tag}_p, property="rotation", amplitude=[1.6, 0, 1.1], period=4.6, phase={ph}, pivot=[{cx}, 2, {cz}])
  output boat_{tag} = bh_${tag}_r
  bd_{tag}_s = poly.script@1(code="${jsrope} ${jsp} ${jb2} boat(${cx}, ${cz}, ${yaw}, ${L}, ${B}, 1)")
  bd_{tag}_m = solid.material@1(bd_${tag}_s, color=[0.7, 0.62, 0.48], roughness=0.8)
  bd_{tag}_p = anim.parent@1(bd_${tag}_m, parent="boat_${tag}")
  output boat_{tag}_deck = bd_${tag}_p
  bm_{tag}_s = poly.script@1(code="${jsrope} ${jsp} ${jb2} boat(${cx}, ${cz}, ${yaw}, ${L}, ${B}, 2)")
  bm_{tag}_m = solid.material@1(bm_${tag}_s, color=[0.32, 0.22, 0.13], roughness=0.8)
  bm_{tag}_p = anim.parent@1(bm_${tag}_m, parent="boat_${tag}")
  output boat_{tag}_mast = bm_${tag}_p
  bw_{tag}_s = poly.script@1(code="${jsrope} ${jsp} ${jb2} boat(${cx}, ${cz}, ${yaw}, ${L}, ${B}, 3)")
  bw_{tag}_m = solid.material@1(bw_${tag}_s, color=[0.05, 0.07, 0.1], metallic=0.2, roughness=0.1)
  bw_{tag}_p = anim.parent@1(bw_{tag}_m, parent="boat_${tag}")
  output boat_{tag}_windows = bw_${tag}_p
end
# two a side at the jetty (bows to sea, +x), a launch at its end, three alongside the quay (bows +z)
boat("a", 5, -74.6, 1.5708, 10, 3.2, 0, 0.0)
boat("b", 17, -74.4, 1.5708, 9, 3.0, 1, 0.3)
boat("c", 7, -65.4, 1.5708, 11, 3.4, 2, 0.6)
boat("d", 19.5, -65.6, 1.5708, 8.5, 2.9, 3, 0.9)
boat("e", 29, -70, 1.5708, 7, 2.6, 1, 0.45)
boat("f", -7.0, -104, 0, 10.5, 3.3, 0, 0.2)
boat("g", -7.0, 70, 0, 9.5, 3.1, 2, 0.7)
boat("h", -7.0, 100, 0, 8, 2.8, 3, 0.15)

# ---- gulls: two flocks gliding in rings (the whole flock turns slowly about its ring's centre) ----
gulls_a_s = poly.script@1(code="${jsp} ${jg} gulls(0, 10, 14, 30, 1)")
gulls_a_m = solid.material@1(gulls_a_s, color=[0.94, 0.94, 0.92], roughness=0.8)
gulls_a_t = anim.track@1(gulls_a_m, property="rotation", keys="0:0,0,0; 20:0,180,0; 40:0,360,0", interpolation="linear", pivot=[0, 0, 10])
output gulls_over_ship = gulls_a_t
gulls_b_s = poly.script@1(code="${jsp} ${jg} gulls(70, 118, 9, 14, 90)")
gulls_b_m = solid.material@1(gulls_b_s, color=[0.94, 0.94, 0.92], roughness=0.8)
gulls_b_t = anim.track@1(gulls_b_m, property="rotation", keys="0:0,0,0; 15:0,-180,0; 30:0,-360,0", interpolation="linear", pivot=[70, 0, 118])
output gulls_over_mole = gulls_b_t

# ---- the hills: conifers placed by the same height formula as the land (so each stands on the ground), two sets: near (dense) and far (sparse) ----
tree_s = poly.script@1(code="${jsp} function cone(m, y0, y1, r, n) { const f = two(m), a = [], t = m.vertex(0, y1, 0); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const q = TAU * i / n; a.push(m.vertex(r * Math.cos(q), y0, r * Math.sin(q))); } for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) f(a[i], a[(i + 1) % n], t); } const m = new Mesh(); cyl(m, 0, 0, 0, 1.3, 0.22, 0.16, 5); cone(m, 0.8, 4.8, 2.0, 6); cone(m, 2.8, 6.4, 1.6, 6); cone(m, 4.6, 7.8, 1.15, 6); m")
tree_m = solid.material@1(tree_s, color=[0.13, 0.27, 0.13], roughness=0.9)
tree_t = solid.texture@1(tree_m, tile=9, size="256", program="n = fbm(scale_x=6, scale_y=6, iterations=4); albedo = colorize(n, gradient=[0:#16301a, 0.5:#27471f, 1:#4a6a2a]); roughness = n; height = n")
trees_near = inst.program@1(tree_t, count=700, code="a = fract(sin(i * 12.9898 + 1.3) * 43758.5453); b = fract(sin(i * 78.233 + 5.1) * 43758.5453); x = -78.0 - a * a * 900.0; z = (b - 0.5) * 480.0; ${land_h} out = vec3(x, h - 0.4, z);", scale_code="out = 0.8 + 1.0 * fract(sin(i * 4.37) * 9731.3);", yaw_code="out = fract(sin(i * 9.1) * 1234.5) * 360.0")
output trees_near = trees_near
trees_far = inst.program@1(tree_t, count=500, code="a = fract(sin(i * 17.131 + 2.7) * 43758.5453); b = fract(sin(i * 51.77 + 9.3) * 43758.5453); x = -300.0 - a * 900.0; z = (b - 0.5) * 1400.0; ${land_h} out = vec3(x, h - 0.4, z);", scale_code="out = 1.6 + 1.6 * fract(sin(i * 4.37) * 9731.3);", yaw_code="out = fract(sin(i * 9.1) * 1234.5) * 360.0")
output trees_far = trees_far

# ---- the open sea beyond the animated one (400 m square): flat water planes to the horizon, the same colour, level 2 ----
sea_e = water.surface@1(size=[1500, 1700], level=2, color=[0.04, 0.17, 0.26], opacity=1, wave_height=0.5, wave_length=22, resolution=40)
sea_e_a = xform.move@1(sea_e, by=[950, 0, 850])
output sea_far_east_a = sea_e_a
sea_e_b = xform.move@1(sea_e, by=[950, 0, -850])
output sea_far_east_b = sea_e_b
sea_n = water.surface@1(size=[400, 1500], level=2, color=[0.04, 0.17, 0.26], opacity=1, wave_height=0.5, wave_length=22, resolution=32)
sea_n_a = xform.move@1(sea_n, by=[0, 0, 950])
output sea_far_north = sea_n_a
sea_s = water.surface@1(size=[400, 1500], level=2, color=[0.04, 0.17, 0.26], opacity=1, wave_height=0.5, wave_length=22, resolution=32)
sea_s_a = xform.move@1(sea_s, by=[0, 0, -950])
output sea_far_south = sea_s_a
